decision_authority: Model interpretation of biome, elevation, relief, low-relief, vegetation and topology maps; not a kmeans semantic verdict
interpretation: The specified NGEO-009 is one low connected island with a coastal/savanna matrix and a modest southern arid-highland rise. Attribute contrasts and cave/shore exceptions exist, but the 2..5 numerical alternatives do not establish 2..5 robust discrete spatial regions. Retain one SIRZ reference unit with continuous/internal thematic variation, not a claim of uniformity.

alternatives_review.2: Separates fragmented shoreline and relief exceptions from most of the low island; not two independent island lobes.
alternatives_review.3: Mixes coastal fringe with southern higher attributes; fragmented classes do not establish three discrete geographic zones.
alternatives_review.4: Recognizes coastal, savanna-like and southern arid-highland contexts plus tiny cave/high-step exceptions; useful thematic decomposition, not four coherent regions.
alternatives_review.5: Adds more shoreline/vegetation fragments and cave exceptions rather than a robust fifth macro region.

boundary_confidence: SUPPORTED current island surface outline; INSUFFICIENT evidence for discrete internal zone boundaries
transition_limitations: Kmeans attributes at 16-block tiles do not imply exact environmental boundaries. Biome, relief and vegetation transitions overlap. SIRZ-001 is an observation/reference unit, not a political or future REG ID.
scope_caveat: Owner has not supplied precise coordinates for the two western pieces. The central apparent island is a peninsula connected to the separate eastern ROI-edge landbody. The eastern landbody extends beyond this bounded study; do not transfer NGEO-009 results to that larger area.
ROI_extension: 0; minimum ROI includes the complete target island and the visible central-lobe/eastern-neck connection. Larger eastern landbody is explicitly censored, not silently redefined as the target.
